def gf2_affine(eq,n=30):
    rows=[[v, rhs] for v,rhs in eq]
    piv=[]; ri=0
    for col in range(n):
      pivot=next((q for q in range(ri,len(rows)) if rows[q][0]>>col&1),None)
      if pivot is None: continue
      rows[ri],rows[pivot]=rows[pivot],rows[ri]
      pv,pr=rows[ri]
      for q in range(len(rows)):
        if q!=ri and (rows[q][0]>>col&1): rows[q][0]^=pv; rows[q][1]^=pr
      piv.append(col); ri+=1
    if any(v==0 and rhs for v,rhs in rows): return None
    free=[c for c in range(n) if c not in piv]
    def solve(assign):
      val=sum((assign>>k&1)<<c for k,c in enumerate(free))
